articles.title: Java Concurrency and Keyed Entity Locking
articles.author: Denis Stepulenok
articles.summary: Designing per-entity mutex synchronization in JVM memory using ConcurrentHashMap, per-key ReentrantLock instances, and canonical key ordering — plus an honest look at lock-registry eviction races.

articles.title: Kafka Consumer Behaviour, Idempotency, and the Transactional Outbox
articles.author: Denis Stepulenok
articles.summary: Why consumer rebalances and dual writes break naive event pipelines, how partitioned key ordering interacts with retry topics, and where transactional outbox plus idempotent consumers restore safety.

articles.title: PostgreSQL Row-Level Locking for Concurrent Worker Queues
articles.author: Denis Stepulenok
articles.summary: Comparing SELECT FOR UPDATE, NOWAIT, and FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED when implementing multi-worker job claims on top of a relational database.

articles.title: Rust and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for Local Archive Retrieval
articles.author: Denis Stepulenok
articles.summary: Structuring read-only stdio MCP tools in front of a hybrid lexical and vector retrieval index so coding or research agents inspect narrow evidence without exfiltrating raw archives.

articles.title: Automated Testing, Deterministic Validation Gates, and Software Reliability
articles.author: Denis Stepulenok
articles.summary: Treating static HTML, ATS PDFs, confidentiality scanning, and WCAG accessibility as machine-checked build gates rather than manual post-hoc checklists.
